messages:
sam: Quick sync — token-cost attribution pipeline + latency tag schema. Goal is to finalize schema and owners for cutover next Thursday. Delta from last week: PRs open, runtime dependency on KV cache tags. Can owners confirm timelines and blockers?

mia: Status update: draft schema in PR #422 (analytics/ingest). Added fields: `token_count`, `model_variant`, `latency_p50_ms`, `latency_p95_ms`, `route_id`. Putting a sample event below. Will add docs. :memo:

```json
{
  \"event_type\": \"inference_response\",
  \"timestamp\": 1769304400,
  \"route_id\": \"chat/default\",
  \"model_variant\": \"redwood-v1-4q\",
  \"token_count\": 48,
  \"latency_p50_ms\": 120,
  \"latency_p95_ms\": 210
}
```

pranav: Important ask from finance: we need a `cost_model_version` tag so offline mapping can compute per-token unit price. Also suggest `kv_cache_hit` (bool) so cached tokens are accounted separately. @mia can you add those to the schema?

jordan: Runtime note: exposing `route_id` and `model_variant` in the request context + event emitter is straightforward but touches hot path of response emission. I estimate ~1 developer day + tests. Blocking question: do we rename existing `model` -> `model_variant` or keep both for compatibility? Changing name will require catalog + console updates.

ava: From product: prefer single canonical `model_variant` name to avoid ambiguity with model catalog `model_id`. We can do a translation layer in the console. Also please include `cost_model_version` as optional string.

sam: Owners proposed: analytics/ingest = mia; runtime emitter = jordan; cost mapping/finance hooks = pranav; QA / DevEx test harness = lisa. Milestones: schema sign-off by Tue (1769370000), PR merge Wed, staged canary Thu. Is that feasible?

mia: I'll update PR with `cost_model_version` and `kv_cache_hit` and add a small mapping doc. Will also attach a sample event generator. Ping @lisa for QA samples.

pranav: One more: please emit `cached_tokens` when `kv_cache_hit` is true so attribution can subtract those from billable token_count. Example: `token_count` -> total, `cached_tokens` -> number cached.

jordan: A heads-up on perf: adding two small tags won't significantly affect serialized size, but enrichment on the hot path (lookups for cost_model_version) could add ~0.5-1ms unless we cache mapping locally. I'll prototype a fast in-memory map and share bench numbers by EOD. :bar_chart:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary environment for ingest v0.8 is up: https://canary.ingest.redwood.internal — events landing to test bucket `ingest-canary` (retention 48h).

lisa: I'll write QA cases tomorrow. Need: sample generator, instructions to simulate streaming (chunked tokens) vs full-response (single event), and expected attribution checks. If @jordan posts bench numbers I'll add performance regression thresholds.

mia: Added a quick generator in PR body: `curl -XPOST https://canary.ingest.redwood.internal/events -d @sample_event.json` and a small script to toggle `kv_cache_hit`. I'll attach examples to PR comments.

sam: OK — owners and next steps: Mia update schema + PR, Jordan adds emitter + bench, Pranav wires finance mapping, Lisa writes QA, we cut canary Thu. If any blockers surface, call it out here. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

jordan: Will post a micro-benchmark and a short checklist for rollout (feature flag, config, migration plan) by EOD.

mia: FYI added tests in PR for backward compatibility (accept both `model` and `model_variant` for 2 weeks) and a migration note.

sam: Great. Keep pings light, update PRs/checkboxes as things land. :eyes:
